name: todo-list
description: Keeps a running list of open items from the conversation and shows it above the prompt.

default_view.title: Default view
default_view.description: Which view a new or resumed session starts in: the band above the prompt, or the pane beside the transcript. The pane opens only where there is room for it; otherwise the band stays. Takes effect at the next session start.

language.title: Item language
language.description: The language item titles and details are written in, such as English or zh-TW. When empty, it falls back to Claude Code's language setting, then to the language the agent answers in. Takes effect on the next turn; items already on the list keep their language.

band_max_items.title: Items in the band
band_max_items.description: The most items the band above the prompt shows at a time. The pane is not limited by it. Takes effect on the next draw.
